purpose: Fresh terse player-language Gate 3 tranche I benchmark authored after r19 deployment and not used to construct r19.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored after production health reported r19 and was not used to construct r19.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade this tranche after its first paid live run.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H player-language questions.
Semantic criteria are limited to the answer actually requested.

cases.question: deck short. shuffle discard to finish draw?
expectedSourceGroups: When a Draw Pile cannot complete a draw, shuffle the Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Shuffle the Discard Pile into a new Draw Pile and complete the draw.

cases.question: +1 action in opening = another opening action?
expectedSourceGroups: increases the number of Actions permitted in that phase

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. +1 Action during Opening permits another Action in that current phase.

cases.question: negated tactic goes discard still?
expectedSourceGroups: a negated Tactic still goes to its owner's Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Unless another effect changes the destination, a negated Tactic goes to its owner's Discard Pile in the Aftermath.

cases.question: retreat counts as movement trigger?
expectedSourceGroups: Retreat does not count as ordinary movement

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Retreat is not ordinary movement for effects unless a rule says otherwise.

cases.question: already 2 command, normal win gives 3?
expectedSourceGroups: Command cannot exceed the current maximum

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Without a maximum-increasing effect, Command remains capped at 2.

cases.question: already ratified terms accepted. +1 influence?
expectedSourceGroups: already-ratified Proposal grants no default ratification reward

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Reaccepting an already-ratified Proposal does not grant the normal new-ratification reward.

cases.question: treasury cards use asset slots?
expectedSourceGroups: Treasury is not the Asset Bank and uses no Asset capacity

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Treasury cards do not use Asset capacity.

cases.question: mission condition met. auto complete?
expectedSourceGroups: Satisfying the requirement does not complete it automatically

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Completing the Mission requires its Denouement Action.

cases.question: progress 4, they control 4. special op ready?
expectedSourceGroups: Operation Progress exceeds the number of Territories the opponent controls

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Operation Progress must be greater than the opponent's controlled Territories.

cases.question: one rite active. can start another?
expectedSourceGroups: You may have only one begun but incomplete Rite

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Only one begun but incomplete Rite may exist at a time.

cases.question: ritual bound, i defend and win. ritual victory?
expectedSourceGroups: The Mystic must initiate the final battle

semanticCriteria.statement: No. The Mystic must initiate and win the final Ritual battle.

cases.question: purge an asset costs 2 conviction?
expectedSourceGroups: Choose one opposing Asset and put it in its owner's Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. The opposing-Asset Purge costs 2 Conviction.
No. Rout requires winning as the attacker.

cases.question: line of credit twice same turn?

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Line of Credit applies only to the first Deed purchase that turn.

cases.question: materia already drew. second sacrifice draw?
expectedSourceGroups: Once per turn · First qualifying sacrifice from Hand

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Materia Prima triggers only once per turn.

cases.question: final judgment used. normal purge still available?
expectedSourceGroups: does not consume the once-per-turn permission to spend an Action on Purge

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Final Judgment does not consume the normal once-per-turn Action Purge permission.

cases.question: mission would fail, deep cover sends it hand?
expectedSourceGroups: return that Mission to your Hand instead

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Deep Cover can return the failing Active Mission to Hand instead.

cases.question: disruption sent tactic reserve. can pick same one again?
expectedSourceGroups: That specific card cannot be set or chosen again during this battle

semanticCriteria.statement: No. That same card cannot be chosen again during the battle.
